QuestInfo.name: Leaving the Pond
QuestInfo.0: You heard that mysterious voice again. Ask the Elder for advice.
QuestInfo.1: If you want to reach the pinnacle of strength, find the Forest of the Priest in Leafre.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Gritto, the Magician Priest, at Forest of the Priest.

0.0: I'm impressed, #h0#. But you're starting to remind me of a big fish in a small pond. If you want to leave that pond, go to Leafre, village of the Halflingers, and find the Forest of the Priest.\r\n\r\n#r(If you accept, you'll travel there automatically.)

no.0: But there's so much more you can learn! Why are you holding yourself back?

1.0: Welcome to the Forest of the Priest, seeker of knowledge. I am Gritto, Magician Priestess.

npc.0: A journey of a thousand steps begins with one. I guess what I'm trying to say is get your butt over to Leafre.
